subject: general
question: Who was the founder of the Vishishtadvaita philosophy?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ramanujacharya.**__

__
 
• **Vishishtadvaita** is one of the principal branches of Vedanta, a system of Indian philosophy.
 
• The Visishtadvaita system is an ancient one.
 
• **Ramanujacharya**__ is considered the founder of the Vishishtadvaita philosophy.
 
• Ramanujacharya was one of the most important exponents of the Sri Vaishnavism
